Name: Shrek's House
Author: Wandox99
Description:
Hello everyone!
This mod change the Farmhouse with Shrek's House.
This mod can be combined with Shrek Mod Set ([url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14959]Shrek's Swamp[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14956]Donkey as Horse[/url]).
The house can be painted if you don't like the colors.
I recommend downloading the full ModSet:
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14959]Shrek's Swamp[/url];
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14956]Donkey as Horse[/url];
Or at least, the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14959]Shrek's Swamp[/url].


[size=5]Install[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.


The house has a shadow layout I didn't know how to delete.
The Qi quest for the Club Card that ask to watch near the logs on Vanilla Farmhouse is under the 4th rock on


[size=4]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]



If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url] with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels
